questions.q: Processed and meaningful data that is useful for decision making is called ______.
questions.e: Data are raw facts; when processed and given meaning they become information.

questions.q: Which of the following pairs of computer generation and main component is NOT correct?
questions.e: Fourth generation computers used microprocessors (VLSI). Vacuum tubes belong to the first generation.

questions.q: Which of the following storage units is the largest?
questions.e: In ascending order the units are MB, GB, TB and PB, each 1024 times the one before.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an application software?
questions.e: The kernel belongs to the operating system, which is system software. Word processors, accounting packages and browsers are application programs.

questions.q: Which technology characterises third generation computers?
questions.e: Third generation (about 1965-1971) used small- and medium-scale ICs, replacing the discrete transistors of the second generation.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Internet and an intranet.
I. An intranet is a private network that uses Internet technologies such as TCP/IP and web servers.
II. An intranet is accessible to anyone on the public Internet by default.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: I is correct. An intranet is limited to an organisation's users, which is why statement II is false.

questions.q: Google Docs, accessed through a web browser, is an example of which cloud service model?
questions.e: In Software as a Service the vendor hosts the complete application and users simply use it through a browser.

questions.q: The Information Technology Act, 2000 of India is based on the model law on electronic commerce adopted by
questions.e: UNCITRAL (United Nations Commission on International Trade Law) adopted the 1996 Model Law on Electronic Commerce, on which the Act is based.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about the Information Technology Act, 2000 (as amended).
I. Section 66C deals with cyber terrorism.
II. Section 66F deals with identity theft.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Neither is correct. Section 66C covers identity theft and Section 66F covers cyber terrorism. The two are swapped in the statements.

questions.q: The number of bits in 2.5 KB of memory (taking 1 KB = 1024 bytes) is
questions.e: 2.5 × 1024 = 2560 bytes, and each byte has 8 bits: 2560 × 8 = 20480.
